title: How Does a Cable as Wide as a Hose Carry the Internet?
description:
What carries the video on your phone across an ocean? A submarine cable about as wide as a garden hose.
We dive down to the seabed in 3D, cut the cable open to its hair-thin glass fibres, and see what keeps breaking them.
Sources: TeleGeography (Jan 2026).
Animations are simplified illustrations, not exact to scale.
subject: Submarine internet cables
